description.en: Specifies whether to automatically restart the instance.
The network. The value is a JSON string. Only IPv6 is supported. Sample code of an IPv6 network: \[{ "ipType": "public", "ipAddressType": "ipv6" }]

descriptions.zh:
- API调用频率：100次/秒。
- 单用户调用频率：5次/秒。
- 暂不支持内网及IPv4类型。
descriptions.en:
- up to 100 times per second per account.

- up to 5 times per second per user.

- Internal networks and IPv4 addresses are not supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens add-network-interface-to-instance --instance-id yourInstance_ID --networks ipType_:_public_,_ipAddressType_:_ipv6 --auto-start true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens AddNetworkInterfaceToInstance --region cn-hangzhou --Networks 'ipType_:_public_,_ipAddressType_:_ipv6' --InstanceId yourInstance_ID --AutoStart true
